# Lead Gen Facebook Ads

Course 4 of the Ads Clinic classroom (Nick Boddington). Course page: https://www.skool.com/theadsclinic/classroom/3df5f60b

> This module shows you how to build high-converting campaigns - from choosing the right objective (instant forms vs website) to writing ad copy that filters time-wasters.

Perfect for bookings, enquiries, or applications.

**Source note:** lesson text as published in Skool, plus video transcripts cleaned from the English closed captions of Skool-hosted lesson videos (auto-generated captions: filler words and stutters removed, otherwise verbatim, so expect occasional mis-heard words). Lessons whose video is a YouTube link have no transcript. Images in lessons are omitted.

## What does success look like?

Source: https://www.skool.com/theadsclinic/classroom/3df5f60b?md=d4ff9dc5e157437dba05980d8417a2c4

It’s more than just collecting emails. 

In this video, we define what *real* success looks like in lead generation — from cost per lead and conversion rates to lead quality and follow-up performance. Know your benchmarks, track your ROI, and build a list that actually converts.
